use_when: 数据防泄漏
DLP
文件加密
权限管理
加密分享
如何为企业机密文件配置DLP权限并生成加密的.dlp文件？
如何在应用中适配DLP加密分享功能，支持发送和查看DLP文件？
如何为机密文件设置只读、编辑、拥有者等不同权限级别？
如何通过DLP沙箱机制限制文件的网络访问、截屏和剪切板操作？
如何实现基于账号认证的文件授权访问机制？
如何搭建云端对接模块完成端云协调的鉴权和解密？
当你的应用需要保护敏感文件、防止数据泄漏时使用本服务
典型场景包括企业机密文档的加密分享、政府文件的权限管控、金融数据的安全传输等
数据所有者可以为不同接收者设置不同的访问权限，确保文件在传输和存储过程中的安全性
当你的应用需要适配DLP加密分享功能时，参考适配加密分享文档，实现DLP文件的发送和查看流程
应用开发者可以基于DLP沙箱机制，在无需大幅改造应用的情况下实现数据防泄漏保护
给文档导出加上 DLP 加密并生成受控分享文件 / Add DLP encryption to exported documents and generate protected shareable files
接入 DLP 文件查看能力并按权限打开加密文件 / Integrate DLP file viewing and open encrypted files based on permissions
为敏感附件设置禁止转发、禁止复制和禁止截屏限制 / Apply no-forward, no-copy, and no-screenshot restrictions to sensitive attachments
实现企业内部文件按接收人分级授权访问 / Implement recipient-based permission control for internal files
发送机密文件时附带只读或可编辑权限策略 / Send confidential files with read-only or editable permission policies
在应用里识别并处理 .dlp 加密文件 / Detect and handle .dlp encrypted files in the app
为受保护文件接入账号登录后的鉴权解密流程 / Add post-login authorization and decryption for protected files
限制 DLP 沙箱中文件的网络外发和剪贴板访问 / Restrict network exfiltration and clipboard access for files inside the DLP sandbox
管理文件拥有者、编辑者、查看者等安全权限角色 / Manage secure roles such as owner, editor, and viewer for files
实现加密文件的安全分享与权限回收 / Enable secure sharing of encrypted files and revoke permissions later
对接云端服务校验用户权限后再下载解密文件 / Connect to cloud services to verify user rights before downloading and decrypting files
保护合同、报表、客户资料等敏感文件避免二次泄露 / Protect contracts, reports, and customer data from secondary leakage
do_not_use_when: 需求是调用系统身份认证控件，基于锁屏口令、人脸或指纹凭据做本机身份核验，应改用 user-authentication-kit / The requirement is to use system authentication prompts and verify the local user with lock-screen credential, face, or fingerprint; use user-authentication-kit instead

需求是处理 X509 证书、CRL、证书链、CA 凭据生命周期，或创建解析 CMS/PKCS12 内容，应改用 device-certificate-kit / The task is about X509 certificates, CRLs, certificate chains, CA credential lifecycle, or creating/parsing CMS or PKCS12 content; use device-certificate-kit instead
preconditions: 目标设备与系统版本支持 Data Protection Kit/DLP 服务能力 / The target device and OS version support Data Protection Kit/DLP service capabilities
应用已具备处理相关文件分享/查看流程所需的工程配置与依赖，且运行环境可调用系统DLP服务 / The app has the required project configuration and dependencies for file sharing/viewing flows, and the runtime can invoke the system DLP service
涉及账号鉴权与授权校验时，用户已登录可用账号且端云鉴权链路可达 / When account authentication and authorization checks are involved, the user is signed in with a valid account and the device-cloud auth path is reachable
inputs: 待保护的原始文件或文件URI / source file or file URI to protect
目标DLP权限级别与策略参数（只读、编辑、拥有者等） / target DLP permission level and policy parameters (read-only, edit, owner, etc.)
接收方账号标识或授权对象信息 / recipient account identifier or authorization target information
分享、打开或查看DLP文件的业务上下文参数 / business context parameters for sharing, opening, or viewing a DLP file

postconditions.statement: 代码或配置中已明确接入DLP文件发送、打开或查看流程，而非仅做普通文件处理 / The code or configuration explicitly integrates a DLP file send, open, or view flow rather than only ordinary file handling
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set clearly add or modify logic specifically for handling DLP-protected files or DLP sharing/viewing flows, instead of only generic file operations?

postconditions.statement: 已体现对.dlp文件或DLP授权/权限语义的处理，能够区分只读、编辑、拥有者等受控访问场景 / The changes reflect handling of .dlp files or DLP authorization/permission semantics, distinguishing controlled access such as read-only, edit, or owner
postconditions.judge_prompt: By inspecting the edits, is there clear evidence that the implementation handles .dlp files or DLP permission/authorization semantics such as read-only, edit, or owner access?

postconditions.statement: 实现未把需求降级为普通文件存储、预览或凭据保存方案，仍保持DLP防泄漏目标 / The implementation does not downgrade the requirement to ordinary file storage, preview, or credential storage, and preserves the DLP leakage-prevention goal
postconditions.judge_prompt: Do the edits avoid substituting the solution with generic storage, preview, or secret-storage APIs, and instead keep the primary goal as DLP-based leakage prevention?
